name: XLA_FORMULA_FUNCTIONS_B
description: This table contains predefined functions which can be used in subledger formulas.

columns.name: FUNCTION_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of function.

columns.name: FUNCTION_CODE
columns.description: Abbreviated name of the predefined function that can be used in a subledger formula.

columns.name: FUNCTION_DATATYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of functions used in subledger formula. Examples are C for alphanumeric, N for numeric, D for date, B for conditional.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the function is enabled.

columns.name: RETURN_DATATYPE_CODE
columns.description: Data type of the value returned by the function. Examples are C (alphanumeric), N (Numeric), or D (Date).

columns.name: PARAM_COUNT
columns.description: Number of parameters required for the function.

columns.name: PARAM1_DATATYPE_CODE
columns.description: Data type of the parameter 1.

columns.name: PARAM2_DATATYPE_CODE
columns.description: Data type of the parameter 2.

columns.name: PARAM3_DATATYPE_CODE
columns.description: Data type of the parameter 3.

columns.name: PARAM4_DATATYPE_CODE
columns.description: Data type of the parameter 4.

columns.name: PARAM5_DATATYPE_CODE
columns.description: Data type of the parameter 5.

columns.name: PARAM6_DATATYPE_CODE
columns.description: Data type of the parameter 6.

columns.name: PARAM7_DATATYPE_CODE
columns.description: Data type of the parameter 7.

columns.name: PARAM8_DATATYPE_CODE
columns.description: Data type of the parameter 8.

columns.name: PARAM9_DATATYPE_CODE
columns.description: Data type of the parameter 9.

columns.name: PARAM10_DATATYPE_CODE
columns.description: Data type of the parameter 10.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
